prompt:
EXACTLY FOUR separate frames (count them: four rings, not three) of one effect of one effect for a 2D side-view game, painted side by side on one wide flat green field: the red attack warning (tell) a clockwork owl Keeper shows before it strikes. Only the effect is drawn, no creature. The four frames stand in one row on the same horizontal centre line, centres at exactly one eighth, three eighths, five eighths and seven eighths of the picture width, evenly spaced, never touching each other or the edge. Flat, face-on, game-sprite distance; the largest frame spans about a fifth of the picture width.

The look: a flat, matte, hand-inked storybook mark. Opaque salmon-coral (#FF7848) and crimson (#FF3658) shapes with a thin dark-red (#8F173C) etched outline and a little crosshatch, like a woodblock print. NO glow, NO soft gradient, NO bullseye, NO crosshair: the ring is a thick broken ring made of two or three separate curved arc segments with gaps between them, with a small round hub dot in the middle.

Frame 1: a faint thin broken ring of two arcs, small coral hub dot. Frame 2: thicker broken ring of three arcs, a larger hub dot with a dark-red outline, one short crimson tick on the ring. Frame 3: tighter ring, a darker crimson tick and one thin dark-red ray from the hub to the ring. Frame 4: the tightest, fullest ring in crimson with a cream (#FFF5DC) hub, a thin ray and two or three small coral specks beside it.

Outside the shapes the picture is one perfectly flat, saturated, fully vivid chroma-key green #00FF00 (RGB 0,255,0), identical everywhere, no texture, no vignette, no paper. No text, labels, grid, frames or watermark.

Style (required): dark, muted ink on aged paper, like an etched storybook engraving. Etched ink linework with near-black ink outlines; crosshatch and fine line hatching for every shadow and form; visible aged paper grain and fibre texture under all colour; hand-printed, slightly uneven ink. No flat fills, no vector shapes, no smooth digital gradients, no glossy 3D rendering.
